learning_outcomes.text: The Electrical Equipment course is designed to present modern interdisciplinary issues regarding the study of electrical equipment. Through the approached topic, the course is meant to allow students to acquire basic knowledge, in the first stage, on the main phenomena that occur in the operation of electrical appliances, and in the second stage of knowledge on the maintenance of electrical equipment.
The course is also meant to facilitate students to develop skills and competencies in the issue of correct choice of equipment that is part of electrical installations.

The laboratory works are designed to provide future electromechanical engineers with practical skills in the study, maintenance of electrical appliances, construction, research, operation, repair and maintenance of electrothermal installations.

The content of the seminar presented is based on the need to deepen the problems presented in the course. Students have the opportunity to identify electrical supply diagrams of electrical equipment, familiarity with modern means of measuring temperature, electrical parameters during the operation of electrical equipment.

They will understand the complexity and usefulness and maintenance of these facilities and will treat them as such. Knowledge is useful in developing skills in addressing the specific problems faced by a specialist in electromechanics.
Use of fundamental knowledge of electrotechnics
Design and coordination of experiments and tests
Diagnosis, troubleshooting and maintenance of electrical systems and components

syllabus_topics: The place and importance of electrical equipment in industrial installations
Clasification of the electrical devices
Electrical contact
Calculation of resistance and heating of contacts
Thermal effects in electrical equipments
Electromagnet as a component of electrical apparatus
Relays and triggers. Operating characteristics. Constructive types.
Intermediate, current and time relays. Their role, construction and typical patterns of use
Contactors. Their role, construction and typical patterns of use
Low voltage circuit breakers. Principles of electric arc extinguishing
Medium and high voltage circuit breakers. Separators. Role, constructive types
Modern trends in the construction of electrical equipment
Labor protection standards specific to electrical equipment. Basic notions and concerns study of electrical equipment.
Electrical conductors. Constructive types. Calculation of conductors.
Electrical contacts. The influence of the pressing force.
The electromagnet. Construction. Operation.
The electromagnet. The influence of the air gap. Coil cage.
Fuses.
Automatic fuses.
Relays and triggers. Constructive types.
Intermediate relays.
Time relays
Electrical contactors.
Surveillance relays
Realization of a complex scheme on the existing modules in the laboratory. Choice of equipment.
Realization of a complex scheme on the existing modules in the laboratory. Practical realization.

assessment_methods.method: Knowledge assessment test based on laboratory work

assessment_rules: For a grade of 5, all subjects must be treated to minimum standards. For grades higher than 5, all subjects must be treated to standards imposed by the grading scale. In the last laboratory session, students will present the works performed and the results obtained. The minimum performance standard requires carrying out works under teacher coordination to solve specific problems of electrical equipment study and maintenance, maintenance, and diagnosis of electrical equipment, with correct assessment of workload, resources, time, and risks, applying occupational safety and health regulations, and understanding the principle of operation, maintenance diagnosis, and composition of electrical equipment.
